extracted.intended_audience: Canadian patent applicants, patentees, patent agents, and patent examiners (users of the Canadian Intellectual Property Office practice manual)
extracted.subtask_description: Official Manual of Patent Office Practice (MOPOP) providing procedural, formal, substantive and examination standards governing the filing, prosecution, examination, post-grant maintenance and corrections of Canadian patents. Covers communication, time limits, fees, representation, disclosure, claims, patentability tests, special fields (computer, biotech), and remedies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Purpose of the Manual of Patent Office Practice
rubrics_metrics.description: Sets out the purpose of the Manual of Patent Office Practice (MOPOP) as guidance on patent practice and Office procedure.

rubrics_metrics.name: General requirements for submission of written communications
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements to properly submit written communications to the Patent Office (format, content, identification, etc.).

rubrics_metrics.name: General formatting requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Formatting rules for documents submitted to the Patent Office, and exceptions for multi-application communications or identification by application number.

rubrics_metrics.name: Who can communicate with the Patent Office
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules on which persons and representatives are permitted to send communications to the Office on behalf of applicants/patentees.

rubrics_metrics.name: Updating addresses
rubrics_metrics.description: Obligation and procedure for updating contact addresses for applicants, agents, or patentees with the Office.

rubrics_metrics.name: Physical delivery of written communications
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules and practices for delivering documents by regular mail, in person, or designated establishments (Registered Mail, Xpresspost).

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission of documents, information and fees by electronic means
rubrics_metrics.description: Permitted electronic submission channels (online filing, facsimile, ePCT when Canada acts under PCT) and acceptable electronic media/formats.

rubrics_metrics.name: Date of receipt accorded to documents, information or fees
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules determining the date of receipt by the Patent Office for physically delivered and electronically submitted items.

rubrics_metrics.name: Time limits and calculation of time limits
rubrics_metrics.description: How statutory and regulatory time limits are calculated for patent procedures before the Office.

rubrics_metrics.name: Extensions of time
rubrics_metrics.description: Circumstances and procedures for requesting and granting extensions of time, including prescribed/designated days, force majeure, and subsection 3(1) Patent Rules practice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Requirements to obtain a filing date for a regular Canadian patent application
rubrics_metrics.description: Specific documents and information necessary to secure a filing date for a regularly-filed Canadian patent application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Failure to provide all information to secure a filing date
rubrics_metrics.description: Consequences and remedial rules when required filing information/documents are missing at presentation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Description provided in a language other than English or French
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements and procedures when the specification is filed in a language other than English or French, including translations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reference to a previously filed application in place of a description
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules for making a reference statement, providing copies, and translations when relying on a previously filed application’s description.

rubrics_metrics.name: Addition to specification or addition of drawing
rubrics_metrics.description: Timing, effect on filing date, and requirements for adding material to the specification or drawings after filing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application fee and fee formalities
rubrics_metrics.description: Payment requirements for filing fees (amounts, forms, methods, date of payment) and related formalities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Divisional applications — filing requirements and deadlines
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements, deadlines, fees and effects for filing divisional applications and issues relating to originality and public inspection.

rubrics_metrics.name: Compliant Patent Applications (Compliance Requirements)
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards for what constitutes a compliant patent application, including PCT national phase compliance and notices of non-compliance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notice of non-compliance and responses
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedure for the Office issuing a notice of non-compliance and the applicant’s response obligations and timings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Petition practice
rubrics_metrics.description: Use and content of petitions to the Commissioner and related procedural rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inventor information and establishing entitlement
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements for inventor information, declarations or assignments, and procedures to establish entitlement to apply for a patent.

rubrics_metrics.name: Drawings requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Formal standards for patent drawings: content, format, amendments and when photographs are acceptable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sequence listings and electronic form
rubrics_metrics.description: Formatting and submission rules for nucleotide/amino-acid sequence listings and electronic sequence submission requirements (including PCT e-filing).

rubrics_metrics.name: Translation of a description or previously filed application
rubrics_metrics.description: When translations are required, notices requiring translations, and the content and timing of translation submissions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Representation — Register of Patent Agents
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards governing registration of patent agents, updates to agent addresses, registered foreign practitioners, and requirements to appoint an agent.

rubrics_metrics.name: Requirement to appoint a patent agent
rubrics_metrics.description: Circumstances and formalities obliging or permitting appointment of a patent agent and the Commissioner’s practice about requiring an agent.

rubrics_metrics.name: Common representative — appointment and default rules
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules on appointment, notice, default appointment of a common representative for multiple applicants/applications/patents and transfers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Representation Requirements — what actions can be taken by whom
rubrics_metrics.description: List of actions and persons authorized to represent applicants/patentees (filing, paying fees, signing declarations, requesting reinstatement, recording transfers, interviews, etc.).

rubrics_metrics.name: Default Correspondent – Who the Office will correspond with
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules determining the default correspondent for communications from the Office when multiple parties/agents are involved.

rubrics_metrics.name: Disregarded communication
rubrics_metrics.description: Circumstances in which the Office may disregard a communication (e.g., non-common representative, agent not appointed, agent name not provided).

rubrics_metrics.name: Ownership, Inventorship, Transfers and Changes of Names
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards for establishing ownership, maintaining chain of title, adding/removing applicants and inventors, correcting applicant/inventor identity or name, and recording transfers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Priority — claiming priority and related requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: How to request priority, time periods, correction of priority information, submission of certified copies and translations, and restoration of priority rights.

rubrics_metrics.name: Maintenance fees for patent applications and patents
rubrics_metrics.description: Amounts, due dates, late fee periods, methods of payment, deposit account rules, small entity fees and declarations, refunds and waiver policies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Public inspection and confidentiality of applications
rubrics_metrics.description: When applications are open to public inspection, confidentiality rules before publication, early public inspection, and the Canadian Patents Database privacy protections.

rubrics_metrics.name: Abandonment and Reinstatement of patent applications
rubrics_metrics.description: What constitutes abandonment, deemed abandonment under Patent Act subsections, reinstatement procedures, fees, due care determinations, and recommended information for requests.

rubrics_metrics.name: Due care standard
rubrics_metrics.description: Standard and Office procedure for determining 'due care' in reinstatement or reversal of expiry requests and contents of requests demonstrating due care.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tariff of fees and fee payment practice
rubrics_metrics.description: Comprehensive fee schedule, amount due rules, partial payments, request for examination fees and special exceptions (e.g., International application fees).

rubrics_metrics.name: Waiver of fees
rubrics_metrics.description: Circumstances and procedures where the Office may waive fees (e.g., correction or reissue requests, extensions of time in specified situations).

rubrics_metrics.name: Client Service Standards and Performance Targets
rubrics_metrics.description: Service standards and Office performance targets for processing times and client service metrics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Request for Examination — timing and excess claim fee
rubrics_metrics.description: Time limit to request examination, excess claims fee rules, late fee periods and consequences of failing to request examination timely.

rubrics_metrics.name: Examination timelines and advanced examination
rubrics_metrics.description: Office timelines for examination, how to request advancement of examination (special order), green technology processing and Patent Prosecution Highway participation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Examination Process — initial and later examination
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures for initial examination, later examinations, requesting continued examination, and setting aside notices of allowance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Amendments of Patent Applications — voluntary and in response to examiner
rubrics_metrics.description: Permitted amendments (voluntary and in response to requisitions), format and requirements for submitting amendments, statements of purpose, and cover letter guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Suspension of examination
rubrics_metrics.description: Circumstances and practice when examination may be suspended and consequences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fundamentals of Examination — examination of abstract, description and drawings
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards for reviewing the abstract, description and drawings during examination for compliance and sufficiency.

rubrics_metrics.name: Examination of the claims using purposive construction
rubrics_metrics.description: Use of purposive construction for claim interpretation, steps of purposive construction and considerations (fair, balanced informed approach; identify person skilled in the art; common general knowledge; identify problem/solution; determine elements solving problem).

rubrics_metrics.name: Search of the prior art
rubrics_metrics.description: Office practice for searching prior art and what prior art is considered during examination.

rubrics_metrics.name: Examiner’s reports and requisitions
rubrics_metrics.description: Office reports issued by examiners, requisitions concerning foreign applications, biological deposit requisitions, withdrawal of examiner’s reports, and correction of minor errors in reports.

rubrics_metrics.name: Interviews (applicant-initiated and examiner-initiated)
rubrics_metrics.description: Practice and procedure for holding interviews between applicants (or their agents) and examiners, scheduling and content guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Abstracts — content and examination
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards for drafting abstracts including reference characters and examples, and how abstracts are examined.

rubrics_metrics.name: The Description — general requirements of disclosure and proper disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements for sufficient description directed to the person skilled in the art, supplementation by common general knowledge, avoiding misleading statements, presenting the invention without requiring the addressee to solve problems, and disclosure of theory and practical solutions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Functional limitations and applicant as lexicographer
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on functional claim limitations, applicants defining terms (lexicography), and description by reference to the claims or statements expanding scope.

rubrics_metrics.name: Formalities requirements of the description, drawings and related formalities
rubrics_metrics.description: Page numbering, drawings/graphics/tables requirements, trademark identification and document identification rules for the description part of the application.

rubrics_metrics.name: New matter
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards governing adding new matter, general requirements, treatment of applications filed in languages other than English/French, and rules for divisional applications and amendments to divisional applications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Claims — basic requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Fundamental formal and substantive requirements for claims, including clarity, antecedents, ambiguity, negative limitations, completeness, support and dependence/formalities for dependent claims.

rubrics_metrics.name: Principles of construction and clarity of claims
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules for claim construction including antecedents, addressing ambiguities, and treatment of negative limitations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support and scope of claims in relation to description
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirement that claims be supported by the description and drawings, and issues with ranges not specifically described.

rubrics_metrics.name: Specific claim types (product, product-by-process, means, process/method/use, Markush, selection patents)
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance and requirements for various claim types and their particular formal/substantive considerations (including jurisprudence references).

rubrics_metrics.name: Statutory subject-matter and excluded subject-matter
rubrics_metrics.description: What constitutes statutory subject-matter (art, process, machine, manufacture, composition of matter); exclusions (disembodied inventions, scientific principles, methods of medical treatment, higher life forms, forms of energy, printed matter, fine arts, schemes/plans/rules/mental processes, games).

rubrics_metrics.name: Anticipation (novelty) — assessing anticipation and prior art
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards for assessing anticipation including self-anticipation, third-party anticipation, first-to-file priority-based anticipation, prior sale/use, implicit or inherent disclosure and related teachings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Obviousness (inventive step) — assessment framework
rubrics_metrics.description: Framework for assessing obviousness (person skilled in the art; common general knowledge; identifying the inventive concept; identifying differences vs state of the art; whether differences constitute an inventive step), including obvious-to-try, aggregations and relation to utility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Claim date and priority-based claim dating
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules to determine claim date based on multiple previously filed applications and consequences for continuations/continuation-in-part matters.

rubrics_metrics.name: Grace period
rubrics_metrics.description: Legal and procedural considerations regarding grace periods for disclosures by the applicant and effects on novelty/priority.

rubrics_metrics.name: Utility — controllability, reproducibility and sound prediction
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements that inventions be useful, reproducible and controllable, with rules for demonstration or sound prediction and the elements of sound prediction (factual basis, sound line of reasoning, proper disclosure).

rubrics_metrics.name: Unity of invention
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards for unity (one invention only), the general inventive concept, a priori/a posteriori evaluations, examining for unity, content of unity reports, explaining lack of unity and when a lack of unity can be identified, and election of invention procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Computer-Implemented Inventions — subject-matter and examination
rubrics_metrics.description: Scope, subject-matter categories (art/process/machine/manufacture/composition), guidance on examining computer claims, adapting a computer to solve a problem, patentability and programming, examples, utility and sufficiency (written description, source code/pseudocode, common general knowledge), novelty and ingenuity considerations, and claim types specific to computers (method, computer claims, system claims, software product claims, means statements).

rubrics_metrics.name: Biotechnology and Medicinal Inventions — disclosure and claim practice
rubrics_metrics.description: Scope and special considerations for living matter, higher/lower life forms, organs/tissues, processes to produce life forms, bioinformatics, medical methods/uses, kits and packages, diagnostic methods (identifying problem, determining solution, purposive construction), sufficiency of description, nucleic acids/proteins (defining by structure/functional limitation/terminology), sequence listings, deposits of biological materials and Budapest Treaty practice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Protests and filings of prior art prior to grant
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedure for third-party filings of prior art and protests before grant, including confidentiality and how filings are applied by the Office.

rubrics_metrics.name: Allowance, Notice of Allowance and Conditional Allowance
rubrics_metrics.description: Practice around allowance, conditional allowance, amendments after allowance, withdrawal of notice of allowance and issuance of patents upon payment of final fee.

rubrics_metrics.name: Final Actions and Post-Rejection Practice
rubrics_metrics.description: Office final action practice, rejecting an application, Final Action Report, responses to final actions (overcoming and not overcoming), Summary of Reasons and review/appeal processes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Review of a rejected application and appeals
rubrics_metrics.description: Referral to Patent Appeal Board, communication with applicant, opportunity to be heard, decisions without hearing, recommendation to Commissioner, Commissioner’s decision types, and appeals of Commissioner’s decisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Patent maintenance fees, deemed expiry and reversal of deemed expiry
rubrics_metrics.description: Maintenance fee amounts and due dates, late and non-payment consequences, deemed expiry process, reversal of deemed expiry, time periods and due care standards for reversal requests.

rubrics_metrics.name: Corrections to Granted Patents
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures for correcting obvious errors by the Commissioner or re-examination board, errors in naming, obvious errors in specifications or drawings, content/effect of correction requests.

rubrics_metrics.name: Disclaimer practice
rubrics_metrics.description: Filing a disclaimer, roles of the Patent Office and the Courts, and effect of a disclaimer on scope and enforcement of claims.

rubrics_metrics.name: Re-examination — request and two-stage process
rubrics_metrics.description: Process for re-examination including request, first stage determination of substantial new question of patentability, second stage substantive re-examination, completion, effect of certificate, and appeals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reissue — time limits and 'defective or inoperative' requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Time limit for reissue filings, requirement that patent be 'defective or inoperative', error/intent analysis, insufficient description issues, claiming more or less, same invention requirement, forms and examination of reissue applications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Additional Term — eligibility and calculation
rubrics_metrics.description: Eligibility criteria and dates for additional term, process for determination (preliminary notice, observations, certificate or dismissal), calculation rules for duration and periods to be subtracted, reconsideration and Federal Court orders.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transitional Provisions
rubrics_metrics.description: Transitional considerations and how former Patent Rules practices map to current practices for communicating with the Office, filing, compliance, representation and abandonment consequences.
